verdict.rationale: Jitsu's own connector syncs run on a recurring basis as Kubernetes CronJobs, and syncs can be managed through its HTTP API. This gives recurring, scheduled data pulls rather than one-off actions. Scheduling is only implied by the CronJob implementation, and it covers connector syncs only, not general workflows. missing for 10: documented user-configurable schedule/cron settings, scheduling of arbitrary jobs or workflows (e.g., Functions or profile builds on a timer), agent/MCP-driven schedule management, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: connector syncs run as Kubernetes CronJobs
Jitsu exposes an HTTP API for managing workspaces, sites, destinations, connections, syncs and functions.
